name: Sara Balloo's Plea
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
adventurer, I have but a small request to ask of you.

Take this note I have prepared to our great monarch of Ironforge, King Magni Bronzebeard. 'Tis a small task to ask of one such as yourself, someone who has shown great valor to the cause of the Alliance thus far.

For me to go before the King in my grief-ridden state would not serve the purpose of my cause.  Surely you understand.
narrative.objectives: Take Sara Balloo's note to King Magni Bronzebeard of Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: It will take but a moment for me to peruse this letter...
narrative.requestItemsText:
So you are adventurer the Champion? News of your contributions to the Alliance has traveled quite far, you know?

On what business do you come before me today?
